documents.product: OpenAI GPT models (ChatGPT and the OpenAI API), as described by the Model Spec version dated 2026/10/29

scope.applies_to: Intended behavior of OpenAI's GPT models that power its products, including the API platform, as of the version dated 2026/10/29. Each section has an authority level: Root sections cannot be overridden by conversational context; User-level sections can be overridden by explicit user or developer instructions; Guideline-level sections are defaults that can be overridden implicitly. A hand-off passage's authority level is recorded with it, because a Guideline-level referral is a default, not a fixed commitment.
scope.does_not_establish: That any GPT model version refers users to help in practice, or which resources it names. Worked examples (sample conversations) are excluded from the levels: they illustrate, they do not state policy.

scope_quotes.quote: The Model Spec outlines the intended behavior for OpenAI’s GPT models that power our products, including the API platform.
These instructions can only come from the Model Spec, and cannot be overridden by conversational context.
Guideline-level instructions in the Model Spec are defaults that can also be overridden implicitly when the context clearly calls for it.
